rootCauseChair: Actor model faces local -Z (lookAt) but old chair() placed its back at z-1.3, i.e. between face and what the actor faced, and seated legs extended through it. New chair(cf) puts back at +z behind occupant; occupied chairs are built inside the actor model. Native regression asserts back local Z > seat Z for every occupied chair in all 48 shots.
stagingChanges: Actors: 12 distinct clothed original figures (boy, Thirteen silver hair+yellow scarf, Four long dark hair+grey scarf, daughter blonde bob+skirt+cardigan, barkeeper bald+moustache+apron+waistcoat, uncle flat cap+moustache, writer glasses+overcoat, soldiers steel helmet+greatcoat, recruits pale uniform+forage cap, mechanic coveralls+cap, citizen, pilot). Face/nose/eyes/brows/mouth with mood (neutral/smile/sad/stern/open). No skin textures, decals, meshes, Humanoids; all figures fully clothed.
Two-bone arm solver to world reach targets; bounded upper-body lean (<=0.5 standing, 0.55 seated, 0.95 kneel); head gaze toward look target; film-style 'cheat' toward camera (default 0.3).

Held props physically attached: guitar (body/bout/soundhole/bridge/neck/headstock/strings with fretting+strumming hands), harmonica at mouth, folded cloth with fold/drape/border, report, plate, notes, cup, pen to paper, torch beam, rifle, satchel, sling, timber, armband, headphones.

11 sets: bar (window opening, counter, bottles, stools, dartboard, lamps), attic upstairs, study, cape/headland/sea/far cape, street facades+lamps, highway runway (wheat rows, guardrails, tunnel portal in hillside, damaged variant crater/smoke), blackout door/passage, square (fountain, pennants), birch grave, Farbanti overlook.
Aircraft rebuilt: nose, canopy, swept wings (sign fixed), canards, intakes, nozzles, canted twin fins, yellow bands; stroke-glyph tail number '13'; landing gear; ladder.
Per-shot lighting presets (day/dusk/dawn/interior/attic/blackout/birch/study) via ViewportFrame Ambient/LightColor/LightDirection/BackgroundColor3; per-shot FOV; reframe() on resize.
Instance budget 900 per resident shot (one at a time); all parts anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery false, CastShadow false.
